reason: Holds. humanize has no 400 branch. The class-name auth heuristic does not match ClientError or BadRequestError, and neither error text trips the connection keywords, so both fall through to code='unknown' with 'Try again or switch provider'. Gemini validate_key treats only 401/403 as a bad key and re-raises the 400. The route turns that into ok=false with a misleading 'transport error' detail, so entry-time validation still rejects the key. Low is right.
